HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAKE THE BELIEF BET // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. State Belief — State the belief as a clear forecast.
2. Choose Safe — Choose a safe, small action that could prove it wrong as well as right.
3. Hold In Your Mind Expected — Hold the expected result before acting.
4. Test Observation — Run the test, then compare observation with prediction.
5. Pay Out — Pay out only to evidence.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Pay Out is your cue to stop.

rituals.title: THE EFFORT STAIRCASE
rituals.name: THE EFFORT STAIRCASE
rituals.unique_game_move: Open at Name; close at Climb Stair. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.recognition_cue: When your mind keeps delaying the first move, The Effort Staircase gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.situation: When your mind keeps delaying the first move, The Effort Staircase gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.immediate_need: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.challenge: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When your mind keeps delaying the first move, The Effort Staircase gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

GAME MOVE
Open at Name; close at Climb Stair. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE EFFORT STAIRCASE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Name — Name five versions of the task from almost easy to genuinely stretching.
2. Cross Out — Cross out the zero-effort decoy.
3. Remain Version — Do the smallest remaining version that leaves visible evidence—one paragraph, one call, one plate washed.
4. Climb Stair — Next time, climb only one stair.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Climb Stair be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Name, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Remain Version, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Climb Stair, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

rituals.title: MOOD HAS ALIBIS
rituals.name: MOOD HAS ALIBIS
rituals.unique_game_move: One round only: enter at Choose Activity, finish at Repeat Different.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Mood Has Alibis when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use Mood Has Alibis when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.challenge: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Use Mood Has Alibis when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Test what the day does to the feeling.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Choose Activity, finish at Repeat Different.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOOD HAS ALIBIS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Activity — Choose one activity.
2. Score Expected — Before it, score expected mood; at the start, Notice actual mood; at the end, score again.
3. Add Sentence — Add one sentence about what changed during the activity.
4. Repeat Different — Repeat with three different actions before deciding ‘nothing helps.’.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Repeat Different and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Choose Activity, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Add Sentence, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Repeat Different, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Test what the day does to the feeling.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Repeat Different, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Activity → Score Expected → Add Sentence → Repeat Different

PAUSE
Seek professional support if low mood is severe, persistent, or linked to self-harm thoughts.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

Test what the day does to the feeling.

🎮 MOOD HAS ALIBIS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Activity — Choose one activity.
2. Score Expected — Before it, score expected mood; at the start, Notice actual mood; at the end, score again.
3. Add Sentence — Add one sentence about what changed during the activity.
4. Repeat Different — Repeat with three different actions before deciding ‘nothing helps.’.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Repeat Different and release the exercise.

1. To open Choose Activity, slow the next movement by about half.

3. When you reach Repeat Different, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Test what the day does to the feeling.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Repeat Different, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TWO ENGINES // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
One Visible Vote is a tiny mind game for the moment when good enough is being rejected unless it is flawless.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Values become real only after the body votes.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Choose Value first, Tiny last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE VISIBLE VOTE // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Choose Value — Choose a value and design its smallest public evidence: send the honest line, open the document, place the medicine beside water, step outside for two minutes.
2. Complete Shift — Complete it before upgrading the plan.
3. Tiny — A tiny enacted vote outranks a perfect private speech.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Tiny, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Choose Value, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Complete Shift, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Tiny, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Values become real only after the body votes.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found the point where enough really was enough.”

rituals.title: OBJECTIVE OVER EGO
rituals.name: OBJECTIVE OVER EGO
rituals.unique_game_move: Open at Picture Real; close at Select Works. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.recognition_cue: Objective Over Ego gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
rituals.situation: Objective Over Ego gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
rituals.immediate_need: The best move may not be the most satisfying proof.
rituals.challenge: The best move may not be the most satisfying proof.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Objective Over Ego gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The best move may not be the most satisfying proof.

GAME MOVE
Open at Picture Real; close at Select Works. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OBJECTIVE OVER EGO // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Real — Picture the real objective in seven words or fewer.
2. Name — Name the action that advances it and the action that merely wins, punishes, impresses, or avoids embarrassment.
3. Imagine Tomorrow — Imagine tomorrow’s result after each.
4. Select Works — Select what works, even if the ego receives no trophy.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Select Works be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Picture Real, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Imagine Tomorrow, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Select Works, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: The best move may not be the most satisfying proof.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COOL THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Use Cool — Use cool—not painfully cold—water or a wrapped cool pack on the cheeks and around the eyes for a brief interval.
2. Slow — Slow your body while the sensation lands.
3. Remove Name — Remove it, name the room, and reassess the next safe action.
4. Test Endurance — Cooling is a reset cue, not a test of endurance.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Test Endurance, you are done.

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LONGER OUT-BREATH // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Breathe Pulling — Breathe in without pulling extra air.
2. Let Outflow — Let the outflow last slightly longer, as though fogging a distant window silently.
3. Repeat Comfortable — Repeat only while comfortable; keep shoulders quiet and jaw loose.
4. Breathe Workable — After several rounds, resume natural breathing and look for one workable decision.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Breathe Workable and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:

2. At Repeat Comfortable, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Breathe Workable, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

2. Picture Card — Picture it on a card and forbid checking, asking, or mentally solving until a set time.
3. Carry Unanswered — Carry the unanswered card while doing normal life.
4. Dont Whether — At review, Notice what the urge did—not whether certainty arrived.

⚡ END MOVE — Dont Whether. No second lap.

Safety behaviours can hide the safety you are trying to learn.

Open at Identify Protective; close at Observe Outcome. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REMOVE ONE INVISIBLE CRUTCH // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Identify Protective — During a manageable exposure, spot one protective act that is unnecessary: gripping, rehearsing, sitting by the exit, checking pulse, carrying reassurance.
2. Drop Legitimate — Drop only that act while keeping legitimate safety intact.
3. Observe Outcome — Observe what the outcome says without it.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Observe Outcome be enough.

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Learning that works in one room may not travel by itself.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Repeat Mastered, finish at Turn Local.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE LESSON // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

rituals.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Smallest to Let Determine.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Smallest to Let Determine.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN UP THE WHISPER // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Smallest — Notice the smallest spontaneous tendency: sway, curl, stretch, turn, reach.
2. Pause Enlarge — Enlarge it by only ten percent and pause.
3. Ask Whether — Ask whether it brings ease, protection, energy, or nothing.
4. Let Determine — Let the answer determine whether to continue, reverse, or stop.

⚡ FINISH — Let Determine closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Smallest, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Ask Whether, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Let Determine, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.

rituals.challenge: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.

GAME MOVE
Use Say Age as the doorway and State Belongs as the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DATE-STAMP THE PRESENT // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Say Age — Say the full date, your current age, location, and who is here.
2. Name Differences — Name three differences between now and the remembered danger: exits, resources, authority, distance, or choice.
3. State Belongs — Touch one present object while stating, ‘This belongs to now.’.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — State Belongs is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Say Age, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Name Differences, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach State Belongs, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Power may be expressed without becoming a weapon.

GAME MOVE
Let Choose Private begin the game. Let End Hands end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ANGER WITH WALLS // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Choose Private — Choose private space, a timer, and non-harmful materials.
2. State Anger — State the anger plainly, push against a stable surface, tear scrap your imagination, or move strongly without rehearsing violence.
3. End Hands — When time ends, open hands, name the boundary underneath, and select a safe action.

⚡ EXIT — Finish End Hands and leave the game there.

2. At State Anger, separate responsibility from punishment.

about 1 minute

HOOK
When you have lost contact with the ordinary signals around you, Mute The Inner Subtitles gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

GOAL
One ordinary event requires no running review.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Choose Washing to Dont Answer.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MUTE THE INNER SUBTITLES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Choose Washing — Choose washing, walking, eating, or dressing.
2. Duration — For the duration, omit internal narration and meet only sensation and movement.
3. Dont Answer — When commentary resumes, do not answer it; rejoin the activity at the next contact point.

⚡ FINISH — Dont Answer closes the round.

1. Before you begin Choose Washing, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Duration, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Dont Answer, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: One ordinary event requires no running review.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Dont Answer with more choice than you had at Choose Washing.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found the room again through my senses.”

Begin where it says Emotion; stop the moment you complete Stay Blurred.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE EMOTION STOPS AT THE SKIN // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Emotion — Notice where their emotion seems to enter your body.
2. Trace Physical — Trace your physical boundary with gaze or touch.
3. State Action — State what action is yours, what remains theirs, and what you can offer without taking ownership.
4. Stay Blurred — Adjust distance if the distinction stays blurred.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Stay Blurred be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Right before the first move, Emotion, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At State Action, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Stay Blurred, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Another person’s state is information, not automatic duty.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Estimate Much — Name five identities active in your life and estimate how much attention each received this week.
2. Choose Neglected — Choose the neglected role that still matters.
3. Perform — Perform one tiny action from its perspective today—friend, learner, neighbour, artist, caregiver, citizen.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Perform is your cue to stop.

rituals.plain:
OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO

TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When your mind is stuck on the loudest thing, Open The Identity Portfolio makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
One role should not own every share of self.

GAME MOVE
Use Estimate Much as the doorway and Perform as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Estimate Much — Name five identities active in your life and estimate how much attention each received this week.
2. Choose Neglected — Choose the neglected role that still matters.
3. Perform — Perform one tiny action from its perspective today—friend, learner, neighbour, artist, caregiver, citizen.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Perform is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Estimate Much, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Choose Neglected, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Perform, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: One role should not own every share of self.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Perform without having to solve the entire situation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I moved attention from what was loud to what was useful.”

FORMULA FLOW
Estimate Much → Choose Neglected → Perform

rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Imagine Nobody. Stop at Take Smallest. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.recognition_cue: Remove The Audience catches the moment when the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters and gives you another route.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Remove The Audience catches the moment when the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the choice that survives without witnesses.

GAME MOVE
Start at Imagine Nobody. Stop at Take Smallest. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REMOVE THE AUDIENCE // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Imagine Nobody — Imagine nobody will see, praise, criticise, repost, or hear about the action.
2. Erase Audience — Erase the imagined audience one row at a time.
3. Choose Direct — What would you choose if only direct consequences and values remained?
4. Take Smallest — Take the smallest version privately.

⚡ FINISH — Take Smallest closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Imagine Nobody, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Choose Direct, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Take Smallest, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Find the choice that survives without witnesses.

📸 MY RESULT
“I chose one move that matched what matters to me.”

rituals.title: MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA
rituals.name: MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA
rituals.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Place Memory; stop the moment you complete Add Resources.
rituals.recognition_cue: Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
rituals.situation: Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
rituals.immediate_need: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.
rituals.challenge: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Place Memory; stop the moment you complete Add Resources.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Place Memory — Place the memory on a screen with enough visual distance.
2. View Scene — View the scene from above, behind, or beside a compassionate observer.
3. Keep Events — Keep events accurate while changing camera position.
4. Add Resources — Add current-you outside the frame with present resources.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Add Resources be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Place Memory, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Keep Events, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Add Resources, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.

You can finish at Add Resources even if the original thought has not completely disappeared.

📸 MY RESULT
“I caught the pattern early enough to choose.”
rituals.formula_flow: Place Memory → View Scene → Keep Events → Add Resources

3. Use After — Use it after one miss—before a second is negotiated.

⚡ DONE — Complete Use After, then return to your day.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Treat, you are done.

Give yourself one clean run: Picture Safety first, Treat last.

Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Treat, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Picture Safety, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Generate, separate responsibility from punishment.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Treat feels more deliberate than automatic.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found where my responsibility ends.”

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Open at Name; close at Climb Stair. Keep it light and literal.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE EFFORT STAIRCASE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Name — Name five versions of the task from almost easy to genuinely stretching.
2. Cross Out — Cross out the zero-effort decoy.
3. Remain Version — Do the smallest remaining version that leaves visible evidence—one paragraph, one call, one plate washed.
4. Climb Stair — Next time, climb only one stair.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Climb Stair be enough.
items.potency_stack:

2. At Remain Version, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Climb Stair, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TWO ENGINES // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Schedule Chosen — For the next day, schedule one act chosen purely for enjoyment and one chosen for competence.
2. Make Small — Make both small enough to happen.
3. P — After each, CHECK or M and rate whether its own channel received fuel.
4. Dont Demand — Do not demand that either activity fix everything.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Dont Demand and leave the game there.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Schedule Chosen: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At P, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Dont Demand, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can get from Schedule Chosen to Dont Demand without adding another story on top.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

FORMULA FLOW
Schedule Chosen → Make Small → P → Dont Demand

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Install a movement the habit cannot perform beside.

GAME MOVE
Start with Identify Motor. When Decide Consciously appears, the round is over.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BODY VETO // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Identify Motor — Spot the first motor cue—reaching, picking, scrolling, biting, clenching.
2. Choose Safe — Choose a safe opposite posture and rehearse it slowly three times.
3. Enter Posture — When the cue appears, enter that posture for ten seconds while naming the urge.
4. Decide Consciously — Then decide consciously.

⚡ END MOVE — Decide Consciously. No second lap.
items.potency_stack:

1. Just before you start Identify Motor, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Enter Posture, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Decide Consciously, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Install a movement the habit cannot perform beside.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pre-decide the moment that usually steals the decision.

GAME MOVE
Start at Picture Line and keep going only until No.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHEN/THEN FIRMWARE // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Picture Line — Picture one line only: WHEN [specific visible cue], THEN I WILL [small physical action].
2. Remove Vague — Remove vague words such as try, soon, or better.
3. Imagine Cue — Imagine the cue once, perform the action once, and place the rule where the cue occurs.
4. No — No motivational speech required.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — No is your cue to stop.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Picture Line, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Imagine Cue, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach No, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Pre-decide the moment that usually steals the decision.

items.name: THE FIRST DRIFT
items.unique_game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Imagine A Path Sequence first, Tell Support last.
items.recognition_cue: When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The First Drift helps you test what your mind is telling you.
items.situation: When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The First Drift helps you test what your mind is telling you.
items.immediate_need: Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.
items.challenge: Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The First Drift helps you test what your mind is telling you.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Imagine A Path Sequence first, Tell Support last.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIRST DRIFT // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Imagine A Path Sequence — Imagine your sequence backward from the unwanted behaviour: first act, private permission, routine change, environment shift, body state.
2. Put — Put a red dot on the earliest sign you could realistically notice.
3. Tell Support — Attach one interruption to that dot and tell one support person what it means.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Tell Support, you are done.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Imagine A Path Sequence, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Put, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Tell Support, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.

items.t:
THE FIRST DRIFT

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The First Drift helps you test what your mind is telling you.

GOAL
Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Imagine A Path Sequence first, Tell Support last.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIRST DRIFT // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Imagine A Path Sequence — Imagine your sequence backward from the unwanted behaviour: first act, private permission, routine change, environment shift, body state.
2. Put — Put a red dot on the earliest sign you could realistically notice.
3. Tell Support — Attach one interruption to that dot and tell one support person what it means.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Tell Support, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Imagine A Path Sequence, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Put, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Tell Support, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Relapse announces itself quietly before it becomes a return.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The first interpretation feels less final when you reach Tell Support.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped circling and found the next useful point.”

Imagine A Path Sequence → Put → Tell Support

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE VISIBLE VOTE // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Choose Value — Choose a value and design its smallest public evidence: send the honest line, open the document, place the medicine beside water, step outside for two minutes.
2. Complete Shift — Complete it before upgrading the plan.
3. Tiny — A tiny enacted vote outranks a perfect private speech.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Tiny, you are done.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COOL THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Use Cool — Use cool—not painfully cold—water or a wrapped cool pack on the cheeks and around the eyes for a brief interval.
2. Slow — Slow your body while the sensation lands.
3. Remove Name — Remove it, name the room, and reassess the next safe action.
4. Test Endurance — Cooling is a reset cue, not a test of endurance.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Test Endurance, you are done.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BURN THE EXCESS CHARGE // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Choose Burst — Choose a contained burst: fast stairs, wall pushes, brisk marching, or another safe vigorous movement.
2. Set Short — Set a short timer before starting.
3. End Completely — When it ends, stop completely, feel the after-pulse, and drink water.
4. Let Body — Let the body spend energy without spending your future.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Let Body be enough.

2. At End Completely, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Let Body, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Give body alarm a finish line.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

GAME MOVE
Play from Breathe Pulling to Breathe Workable. Treat the last move as the finish line.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LONGER OUT-BREATH // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Breathe Pulling — Breathe in without pulling extra air.
2. Let Outflow — Let the outflow last slightly longer, as though fogging a distant window silently.
3. Repeat Comfortable — Repeat only while comfortable; keep shoulders quiet and jaw loose.
4. Breathe Workable — After several rounds, resume natural breathing and look for one workable decision.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Breathe Workable and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Breathe Pulling, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Repeat Comfortable, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Breathe Workable, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Safe contact gives fear new data.

GAME MOVE

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAY FOR THE UPDATE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose External — Choose an external cue low enough on your fear ladder to approach voluntarily.
2. Enter Escape — Enter without escape and remain until you observe at least one mismatch between prediction and reality.
3. Name Mismatch — Name the mismatch before leaving.
4. Repeat Later — Repeat later under safe conditions rather than chasing maximum distress.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Repeat Later and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:

1. Give yourself one second before Choose External: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Name Mismatch, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Repeat Later, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Safe contact gives fear new data.

items.plain:
STAY FOR THE UPDATE

TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Stay For The Update makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
Safe contact gives fear new data.

GAME MOVE
Let Choose External begin the game. Let Repeat Later end it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAY FOR THE UPDATE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose External — Choose an external cue low enough on your fear ladder to approach voluntarily.
2. Enter Escape — Enter without escape and remain until you observe at least one mismatch between prediction and reality.
3. Name Mismatch — Name the mismatch before leaving.
4. Repeat Later — Repeat later under safe conditions rather than chasing maximum distress.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Repeat Later and leave the game there.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Choose External: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Name Mismatch, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Repeat Later, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Safe contact gives fear new data.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You notice the pull of the old pattern and can still choose Repeat Later.

📸 MY RESULT
“I caught the pattern early enough to choose.”

FORMULA FLOW
Choose External → Enter Escape → Name Mismatch → Repeat Later

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE CONTROLLED REPLAY // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Set Time — Set a start time, endpoint, grounding object, and recovery plan.
2. Recount — Recount or visualise the feared scene at a tolerable pace without changing key facts.
3. Prediction — Notice shifts in prediction or emotion across the telling.
4. Finish Location — Finish by naming present location and date.

⚡ DONE — Complete Finish Location, then return to your day.

TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
The Controlled Replay is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind has left the room for another time or place.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Uncertainty can remain unfinished without becoming an emergency.

GAME MOVE
Take the shortest route: Choose Low → the middle moves → Dont Whether.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LEAVE ONE QUESTION OPEN // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Low — Choose a low-stakes unknown.
2. Picture Card — Picture it on a card and forbid checking, asking, or mentally solving until a set time.
3. Carry Unanswered — Carry the unanswered card while doing normal life.
4. Dont Whether — At review, Notice what the urge did—not whether certainty arrived.

⚡ END MOVE — Dont Whether. No second lap.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Choose Low, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Carry Unanswered, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Dont Whether, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Uncertainty can remain unfinished without becoming an emergency.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAY THROUGH RECOVERY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REMOVE ONE INVISIBLE CRUTCH // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Identify Protective — During a manageable exposure, spot one protective act that is unnecessary: gripping, rehearsing, sitting by the exit, checking pulse, carrying reassurance.
2. Drop Legitimate — Drop only that act while keeping legitimate safety intact.
3. Observe Outcome — Observe what the outcome says without it.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Observe Outcome be enough.

items.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Smallest to Let Determine.
items.recognition_cue: Turn Up The Whisper catches the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new and gives you another route.
items.situation: Turn Up The Whisper catches the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new and gives you another route.
items.immediate_need: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
items.challenge: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Turn Up The Whisper catches the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new and gives you another route.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Smallest to Let Determine.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN UP THE WHISPER // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Smallest — Notice the smallest spontaneous tendency: sway, curl, stretch, turn, reach.
2. Pause Enlarge — Enlarge it by only ten percent and pause.
3. Ask Whether — Ask whether it brings ease, protection, energy, or nothing.
4. Let Determine — Let the answer determine whether to continue, reverse, or stop.

⚡ FINISH — Let Determine closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Smallest, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Ask Whether, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Let Determine, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.

items.unique_game_move: Use Say Age as the doorway and State Belongs as the exit.
items.recognition_cue: Date-Stamp The Present works best when an old danger is crowding into the present. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
items.situation: Date-Stamp The Present works best when an old danger is crowding into the present. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
items.immediate_need: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.challenge: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Date-Stamp The Present works best when an old danger is crowding into the present. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.

GAME MOVE
Use Say Age as the doorway and State Belongs as the exit.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DATE-STAMP THE PRESENT // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Say Age — Say the full date, your current age, location, and who is here.
2. Name Differences — Name three differences between now and the remembered danger: exits, resources, authority, distance, or choice.
3. State Belongs — Touch one present object while stating, ‘This belongs to now.’.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — State Belongs is your cue to stop.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Say Age, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Name Differences, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach State Belongs, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.

GOAL
Reality gets one minute without explanation.

Let Set Brief begin the game. Let Let Sensory end it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 NO-CONCEPT MINUTE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Set Brief — Set a brief interval.
2. Name Comparisons — During it, no diagnoses, causes, labels, comparisons, or solutions may be generated.
3. Attend Direct — Attend to direct colour, sound, contact, and movement.
4. Let Sensory — If a concept appears, acknowledge ‘explanation’ and let the sensory world continue.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Let Sensory and leave the game there.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MUTE THE INNER SUBTITLES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Choose Washing — Choose washing, walking, eating, or dressing.
2. Duration — For the duration, omit internal narration and meet only sensation and movement.
3. Dont Answer — When commentary resumes, do not answer it; rejoin the activity at the next contact point.

⚡ FINISH — Dont Answer closes the round.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Another person’s state is information, not automatic duty.

Begin where it says Emotion; stop the moment you complete Stay Blurred.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE EMOTION STOPS AT THE SKIN // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Emotion — Notice where their emotion seems to enter your body.
2. Trace Physical — Trace your physical boundary with gaze or touch.
3. State Action — State what action is yours, what remains theirs, and what you can offer without taking ownership.
4. Stay Blurred — Adjust distance if the distinction stays blurred.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Stay Blurred be enough.
items.potency_stack:

2. At State Action, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Stay Blurred, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Another person’s state is information, not automatic duty.

🎮 OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Estimate Much — Name five identities active in your life and estimate how much attention each received this week.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Perform is your cue to stop.

items.plain:
OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO

TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When your mind is stuck on the loudest thing, Open The Identity Portfolio makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
One role should not own every share of self.

GAME MOVE
Use Estimate Much as the doorway and Perform as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OPEN THE IDENTITY PORTFOLIO // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Estimate Much — Name five identities active in your life and estimate how much attention each received this week.
2. Choose Neglected — Choose the neglected role that still matters.
3. Perform — Perform one tiny action from its perspective today—friend, learner, neighbour, artist, caregiver, citizen.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Perform is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Estimate Much, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Choose Neglected, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Perform, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: One role should not own every share of self.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Perform without having to solve the entire situation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I moved attention from what was loud to what was useful.”

FORMULA FLOW
Estimate Much → Choose Neglected → Perform

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the choice that survives without witnesses.

GAME MOVE
Start at Imagine Nobody. Stop at Take Smallest. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REMOVE THE AUDIENCE // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Imagine Nobody — Imagine nobody will see, praise, criticise, repost, or hear about the action.
2. Erase Audience — Erase the imagined audience one row at a time.
3. Choose Direct — What would you choose if only direct consequences and values remained?
4. Take Smallest — Take the smallest version privately.

⚡ FINISH — Take Smallest closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Imagine Nobody, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Choose Direct, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Take Smallest, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Find the choice that survives without witnesses.

items.title: MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA
items.name: MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA
items.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Place Memory; stop the moment you complete Add Resources.
items.recognition_cue: Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
items.situation: Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
items.immediate_need: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.
items.challenge: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Move The Memory Camera gives you a quick reset for the moment when the old reaction is running before you notice it.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Place Memory; stop the moment you complete Add Resources.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE MEMORY CAMERA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Place Memory — Place the memory on a screen with enough visual distance.
2. View Scene — View the scene from above, behind, or beside a compassionate observer.
3. Keep Events — Keep events accurate while changing camera position.
4. Add Resources — Add current-you outside the frame with present resources.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Add Resources be enough.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Place Memory, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Keep Events, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Add Resources, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: You can preserve facts without re-entering the old viewpoint.

“I caught the pattern early enough to choose.”

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Open at Question Demands; close at Decide Afterward. Keep it light and literal.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE UNANSWERED URGE EXPERIMENT // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Question Demands — When the question demands an answer, Picture it and delay asking for a short, chosen interval.
2. Track Urge — Track urge intensity at beginning, middle, and end without researching.
3. Decide Afterward — Decide afterward whether information is still needed for action or only for relief.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Decide Afterward be enough.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Question Demands, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Track Urge, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Decide Afterward, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Reassurance can wait while its appetite changes.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Separate existence from likelihood and support.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at State Lines, finish at Plan Probability.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 POSSIBLE IS NOT PROBABLE // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. State Lines — State three lines: It is possible that…; It is probable that…; The evidence currently supports….
2. Dont Allow — Do not allow content to migrate upward without justification.
3. Plan Probability — Base planning on probability and safety margin, not possibility alone.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Plan Probability and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open State Lines, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Dont Allow, ask what a neutral camera could actually record.
3. When you reach Plan Probability, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: Separate existence from likelihood and support.

items.plain:
LET THE WATCHER GO TOO

TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Try Let The Watcher Go Too when you have fallen inside the thought instead of noticing it. It creates just enough space for a different response.

GOAL
Witnessing can become another identity to defend.

GAME MOVE
Start with Subtle. When Ground appears, the round is over.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET THE WATCHER GO TOO // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Subtle — Notice the subtle position that says ‘I am the observer.’ Treat that position, effort, or location as another known experience.
2. Allow Awareness — Allow awareness without maintaining a separate watcher.
3. Ground — Ground through ordinary action immediately afterward.

⚡ END MOVE — Ground. No second lap.

2. At Allow Awareness, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE SYMBOL’S JOB // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Choose Image — Choose the image or object that represents the state.
2. Open Cage — Alter one property—open the cage, cool the metal, add roots, repair the crack, move the weight, give the storm a shoreline.
3. Observe Inner — Observe the inner response and translate it into one practical move.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Inner closes the round.

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Must-have limits should shape the field before desire fills it.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Picture Safety first, Treat last.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Treat, you are done.

2. At Generate, separate responsibility from punishment.

1–2 minutes

HOOK
When your responsibility and someone else's have blurred together, try Constraints Enter Before Options. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.

GOAL
Must-have limits should shape the field before desire fills it.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Picture Safety first, Treat last.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Treat, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Picture Safety, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Generate, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Treat, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Must-have limits should shape the field before desire fills it.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Treat feels more deliberate than automatic.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found where my responsibility ends.”

FORMULA FLOW
Picture Safety → Eliminate → Generate → Treat
